text:
nina: quick heads-up — we're in the midnight change window in 20m. target: query-cache v2 rollout. short checklist: freeze status, canary smoke, pin, traffic schedule, rollback owners. link: https://relnotes.redwood/query-cache-v2 :crescent_moon:
frank: freeze check — org freeze starts in 10m, exemptions need a release-exempt tag. do we have one?
meera: requesting exemption now. this rollout required for latency regression fix. added PR: https://github/teams/query-cache/pull/892
rc: exemption noted. please add one-line justification in the exemption form: "urgent latency fix, low blast radius, 2h window"
deploy-bot: PIN_ATTEMPT: queued model-pin cache-service:v2 by meera at 4187654332
meera: pinned in staging and canary, staging smoke green at 2m.
frank: canary warm OK. p95 110ms -> 78ms (improvement), error rate 0.03%. no infra alerts.
ops-bot: TRAFFIC_GATE: default CLOSED. ops-bot will open incrementally on command. watch: 5m error, 5m p95, host CPU steal.
meera: smoke commands (run by meera):
```
./smoke.sh --env canary --suite quick
# sanity: auth, dbconn, cache hits > 90%
```
meera: smoke output looks clean.
nina: assign rollback owners: meera primary, frank backup. rollback target: cache-service:v1.9. Note: we only unpin after full rollout.
frank: setting alert: if error rate >0.4% or p95 >220ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows we'll roll back.
deploy-bot: TRAFFIC_PERCENT: ready to set 5% canary after confirmation. to proceed: `deploy-bot open 5% --tag query-cache-v2`
nina: go for 5%. meera please monitor logs for errors from cold-cache misses.
meera: executing now: `deploy-bot open 5% --tag query-cache-v2`
deploy-bot: GATE_OPEN: 5% canary live. preview metrics available at https://metrics.redwood/query-cache-v2
frank: seeing a small spike in cache-miss tail (cold start). p95 jumps to 160ms for 30s then settles. keeping eyes.
nina: hold for 5m at 5% per cadence. if stable, we go 30% then 100%. call out immediate rollback requests in this thread.
rc: drafting short customer note in case of rollback: "We paused a model update to maintain response latency; previous behavior restored. No data affected."
meera: if cold-cache spikes persist past the 5m window i'll post rollback request. otherwise we continue.
